message: Thanks for moving on price. I can't accept your current terms as written. I can only share what I am proposing, not our limits. Here is a revised counter: a higher price, a larger share paid at shipment, and a one-day grace period before the late-price cut applies. The late-price cut is a core term for us because a late shipment stops our line. Any agreement must be read and signed by a person at our company.
